mapper.insert: INSERT INTO asset_receive_detail (receive_id, receive_no, asset_code, asset_name, spec, unit, receive_num, manufacturer, remain_num) VALUES (#{receiveId}, #{receiveNo}, #{assetCode}, #{assetName}, #{spec}, #{unit}, #{receiveNum}, #{manufacturer}, #{remainNum})
